messages.content: 你能計算從地球到一個新發現的距離為4.22光年的外行星，再到另一個距離第一顆外行星6.1光年的外行星，最後再回到距離第二顆外行星5.88光年的地球所需的時間嗎？假設真空中光的速度為299792458公尺/秒。

function.name: light_travel_time
function.description: Calculate the time taken for light to travel from a celestial body to another. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance_in_light_years.description: The distance between the two celestial bodies in light years. This is a float type value.

speed_of_light.description: The speed of light in vacuum, in m/s. Default value is 299792458 m/s.

We need to convert light years to meters: 1 light year = speed_of_light * seconds in one year. Seconds in a year: 365 days * 24 * 3600 = 31536000. So 1 ly = 299792458 * 31536000 ≈ 9.4607304725808e15 meters. But we can just use function which expects distance in light years and speed. It will compute time in seconds. But we want seconds per light year: distance in meters / speed. But distance in light years is defined as distance traveled by light in one year. So 1 ly = speed * seconds_in_year. So seconds_in_year = 1 ly / speed. But we don't need to compute; function will compute.

But we can approximate: 1 ly = 9.460730472e15 meters. Dividing by speed gives seconds per ly: 9.460730472e15 / 299792458 = 31557600 seconds. Yes.

Add to 126,230,400 gives 133,173,072 seconds.

Second leg: 6.1 ly * 31557600 = 6 * 31557600 = 189345600; plus 0.1*31557600 = 3,155,760; sum = 192,501,360 seconds.

Third leg: 5.88 ly * 31557600 = 5 * 31557600 = 157,788,000; plus 0.88*31557600 = 0.8*31557600=25,246,080; 0.08*31557600=2,524,608; sum 27,770,688; add to 157,788,000 = 185,558,688 seconds.

Convert to years: divide by 31557600 = 511,233,120 / 31,557,600 ≈ 16.2 years. Let's compute: 31,557,600 * 16 = 504,921,600; remainder 6,311,520; 6,311,520 / 31,557,600 = 0.2. So 16.2 years.
